question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings_master" AS SELECT "building_key" AS "building_key", "building_name" AS "building_name" FROM beaver."buildings";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_enriched" AS SELECT "building_key" AS "building_key", "floor" AS "floor", "room" AS "room", "organization_name" AS "organization_name", "dept_code" AS "dept_code" FROM beaver."fac_rooms";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH rooms_norm AS (
    SELECT
        building_key,
        room,
        organization_name,
        dept_code,
        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(TRIM(floor), '^-?\d+$') THEN CAST(TRIM(floor) AS INTEGER)
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(floor)) IN ('g','gr','ground','l','ll','lower level','b','b1','b2','basement') THEN -1
            ELSE NULL
        END AS floor_num
    FROM rooms_enriched
), per_bldg AS (
    SELECT
        building_key,
        MIN(floor_num) AS lowest_floor_number,
        MAX(floor_num) AS highest_floor_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT room) AS total_rooms,
        ANY_VALUE(organization_name) AS sample_organization_name,
        ANY_VALUE(dept_code) AS sample_dept_code
    FROM rooms_norm
    GROUP BY building_key
)
SELECT
    b.building_key,
    b.building_name,
    p.sample_dept_code AS department_code,
    p.sample_organization_name AS organization_name,
    p.highest_floor_number,
    p.lowest_floor_number,
    p.total_rooms
FROM per_bldg p
JOIN buildings_master b USING (building_key)
ORDER BY b.building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH rooms_norm AS (
    SELECT
        r.building_key,
        r.room,
        r.organization_name,
        r.dept_code,
        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(TRIM(r.floor), '^-?\d+$') THEN CAST(TRIM(r.floor) AS INTEGER)
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(r.floor)) IN ('g','gr','ground','l','ll','lower level','b','b1','b2','basement') THEN -1
            ELSE NULL
        END AS floor_num
    FROM rooms_enriched r
), per_bldg AS (
    SELECT
        building_key,
        MIN(floor_num) AS lowest_floor_number,
        MAX(floor_num) AS highest_floor_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT room) AS total_rooms
    FROM rooms_norm
    GROUP BY building_key
), rep_org AS (
    -- Choose the most frequent organization per building as representative
    SELECT building_key, organization_name
    FROM (
        SELECT building_key, organization_name,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_key ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, organization_name) AS rn
        FROM rooms_norm
        WHERE organization_name IS NOT NULL AND organization_name <> ''
        GROUP BY building_key, organization_name
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
), rep_dept AS (
    -- Choose the most frequent department code per building and format as string
    SELECT building_key, CAST(dept_code AS VARCHAR) AS department
    FROM (
        SELECT building_key, dept_code,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY building_key ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, dept_code) AS rn
        FROM rooms_norm
        WHERE dept_code IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY building_key, dept_code
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    b.building_key,
